title: Jehovah Jireh, my provider,
lyrics_original: His grace is sufficient, for me, for me, for me
His grace is sufficient For me
My God shall supply all my needs
According to His riches in glory
He gives His angels Charge over me

bible_verses.english: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my strength is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jehovah Jireh, thank You for being my faithful Provider in every season of life. Forgive me for the moments I let anxiety take over instead of resting in Your sufficient grace. Today, I anchor my heart in Your promise to supply all my needs according to Your glorious riches. Send Your peace to guard my mind, knowing that You care for me deeply and walk beside me every step of the way. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When worries about tomorrow weigh heavily on our hearts, this song gently redirects our gaze to Jehovah Jireh, the God who provides. His promise is not just to supply our physical needs according to His infinite riches, but also to wrap us in grace that is more than enough for today. As you sing, let go of the burden of self-reliance and trust in His constant, loving care over your life. He sees you, protects you, and faithfully holds your future.
